text_block_list.text:
The day of the Champions Cup arrives.
Chukyo
Racecourse, which also hosts
popular turf races, is
just under
maximum capacity.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон has rediscovered her
original dream
of simply shining, but she
appears nervous. I let
her know that
she'll be all right.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон has rediscovered her
original dream
of simply shining, but she
appears nervous. I let
her know that
she'll be all right.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She decides to shine as bright as she
can. Holding
that feeling close to her
chest, Смарт Фалкон
heads to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
